candidate_workaround: Separate staged-review credit from status postflights and compare precomputed manifest and x1 path sets.
failure_signature: A grouped wrapper timed out after its exact staged-review subprocess had already passed.
recurrence_guard: Do not group a successful staged review with nested large-checkout Git summaries; isolate each postflight and compare precomputed path sets.
rollback: Retain the successful staged-review receipt, discard the incomplete summary, and leave the index unchanged until isolated probes finish.
scope_boundary: Evidence postflight attribution only; the timeout does not invalidate the separately completed staged review.
title: Isolated evidence postflight after review completion
